sentences.en: Recently he has come to realize the significance of married life.
sentences.zh: 最近他开始意识到婚姻生活的意义。

sentences.en: Were you able to read whole pages without understanding their significance?
sentences.zh: 你能否整页阅读而不理解它们的意义？

sentences.en: The familiar place had a new significance for her.
sentences.zh: 对她而言，那个熟悉的地方有了新的意义。
